steps.title: Start with an ADR
steps.narrative: An architect publishes an ADR with a hard requirement. Pathfinder turns that prose into reviewable obligation candidates — without calling an LLM on the assess path.
steps.technical: ADR Markdown needs an H1 title. ingest-adrs builds a content-addressed index. Later stages cite source_path, line ranges, and SHA-256 of the file bytes.

steps.title: Extract and score confidence
steps.narrative: Deterministic extractors find obligation-like statements and band them high, medium, or low. Only the low band is eligible for batch LLM assist.
steps.technical: Confidence combines modality strength, pattern_hint match, and citation quality. Escalation reasons stay on the candidate for review UX.

steps.title: Batch LLM assist
steps.narrative: For low-confidence candidates, assist drafts a normalized statement and suggested pattern. Offline fixtures keep CI green without secrets.
steps.technical: assist-obligations verifies the quote against file bytes and SHA. Proposals are never executable and stay pending_review. Live mode records tokens and estimated USD.

steps.title: Human accept or reject
steps.narrative: A reviewer accepts or rejects the proposal into the append-only review registry. Accept rate becomes a workshop KPI.
steps.technical: accept-assist-proposal maps to RecordReview. Citation drift between proposal and candidate fails closed before the ledger updates.

steps.title: Deterministic assess gate
steps.narrative: PR and issue assessment evaluate requirements with analyzer evidence and binding coverage — still zero runtime LLM calls.
steps.technical: workshop-emit --enforce-assess-llm fails the snapshot if runtime_llm_calls is not 0 on assess workflows.

steps.title: Publish to the command center
steps.narrative: Artifacts land on workshop-data and this Pages app renders drilldowns, ADR dig-ins, cost, and the Sample journey.
steps.technical: Workshop Publish builds the Vite app and deploys with actions/deploy-pages. Local fixtures keep the shell usable when live data is thin.

adr.title: TLS termination at edge
adr.excerpt: All public HTTP traffic must terminate TLS at the edge proxy with certificates managed by the platform.
